'''Cix Trouvee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]] he took part in the [[Battle of Yag'Dhul (Imperial era)|battle of Yag'Dhul]], betting on the outcome of the skirmish in a contest set up by a group of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], however, detected the gamblers and, believing them to be supplying intelligence to the [[Yag'Dhul insurgents|insurgents]], attacked them. Trouvee fled in the ''Millennium Falcon'' with his copilot, [[Waglin]]. However, as they fled, the Imperial [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Desolator (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Desolator'']], [[Laser/Legends|fired]] on them, accidentally hitting two [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE fighters]] and putting the count two above what Trouvee had bet on. Pursued by many beings whom he owed money, Trouvee decided to enter the [[Cloud City Sabacc Tournament]], where he lost his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].

However, after this, his life took a turn for the positive, and he became very lucky. Around the time following the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Trouvee became the vice president of [[Planet Dreams, Incorporated]]. Trouvee [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[43 ABY]].
